mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy during a severe economic downturn, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.2, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50k over two consecutive months indicates weakening labor market momentum, which triggers a risk-off shift in investor sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 50k in two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS growth < 50k for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous contraction in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based collapse in consumer demand, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 90 (index 2017=100) for three consecutive months indicates a severe supply-side contraction, which increases input costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during three consecutive months of INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in housing starts above 600k after a prolonged decline signals renewed confidence in the residential sector and a recovery in consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 600k after two consecutive months below 500k
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST exceeds 600k after two months below 500k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals inflationary pressure that may prompt future rate hikes, leading to a repricing of equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 100k signals a deepening labor market crisis, which increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary intervention and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both UNRATE > 9.5 and PAYEMS < 100k, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption (proxied by RSAFS) combined with a recovery in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a strong rebound in aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both RSAFS and GDPC1 show sustained growth, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.
